name: Plank up-down
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank, body in a straight line.
Lower one arm at a time down to your forearms.
Push back up one arm at a time to the straight-arm plank.
cue: One arm at a time, hips stay still
mistakes: Letting the hips rock side to side.
